    Stop the currently running GROBID Docker container

    grobid_docker_stop.Rd

    Stops the GROBID container started via grobid_docker_start(). By default, the function targets the container registered in the package's internal environment (.checkrefr_env$docker_container_id). An explicit identifier can be provided to stop a different container.

    Usage

    grobid_docker_stop(container_id = NULL, verbose = TRUE)

    Arguments

    container_id

    character(1) or NULL. Identifier of the container to stop. If NULL, uses the container currently registered in .checkrefr_env$docker_container_id. Default: NULL.

    verbose

    logical(1) Display progress messages. Default: TRUE.

    Value

    invisible(TRUE) if the container was stopped (or was not active), invisible(FALSE) if no container could be identified.

    Details

    Since the container was launched with the --rm option (see grobid_docker_start()), stopping it via docker stop also causes its automatic removal by Docker. The package's internal variables (docker_container_id, server_url, mode) are reset after stopping.

    See also

    grobid_docker_start(), grobid_docker_check()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
grobid_docker_start()
grobid_docker_stop()
} # }
